lanes.name: Media-condition tokenizer
lanes.keyInvariant: every bound carries boundary {below, above} with above === below + 1, so (max-width:1024px) and (min-width:1025px) resolve to the same boundary {1024,1025}
defectsFound: nested-group branch returns width-irrelevant for any paren-balanced garbage, defeating the module's own unparsedCount gate

lanes.name: Five-width responsive QA harness
lanes.reproducibility: 10/10 identical verdicts across two independent live runs
newFindingsNotVisibleTo285C: / at 1440: p90 left-edge delta 55px, worst 405px, threshold 48px; the older clip channel calls the clone better here
/ at 700: clone renders 84 of the source's 234 visible images (36%, threshold 50%)
instrumentDefects: PASS unreachable: pixel-JND fires >=1% on every real reconstruction, observed floor 1.72% on a structurally identical pair. Gates must read summary.blockerPairs and majorPairs.
probe does not scroll but the full-page screenshot does, so lazy-revealed content is outside every numeric channel on both sides
measureLandmark silently excludes elements wider than 1.5x viewport, so worse overflow is likelier to be dropped
the p: tag-path correspondence pass matched 0 nodes on every pair; matchedFraction is not a quality signal
retractions: '5/5 exact' reproduction of 28.5C is wrong. 28.5C accepted /pricing baseline was PASS/MAJOR/BLOCKER/BLOCKER/PASS. Honest statement: severity class matched at 5/5 widths, the two PASS widths read MINOR due to the pixel-JND floor.
trust guard was 'load-bearing': it suppressed one MAJOR finding on each of two pairs and changed no verdict
